# Getting Started

Help Scout provides several tools for developers to make magic happen:

- [Apps](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/) - display your own content as an internal sidebar application in the Inbox
- [Beacon](https://developer.helpscout.com/beacon-2/) - live chat, help docs, and a customer portal all in one
- [Inbox API](https://developer.helpscout.com/mailbox-api/) - read and write data to Help Scout inboxes
- [Chat API](https://developer.helpscout.com/chat/) - read and answer live Beacon chats while they are still open
- [Docs API](https://developer.helpscout.com/docs-api/) - read and write data to your Docs sites
- [Webhooks](https://developer.helpscout.com/webhooks/) - get notified about activity in Help Scout

We suggest spending time with [Apps](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/) first, because it’s an easy way to create a lot of value for people on your team. You can be up and running in no time at all by following the [Getting Started guide](https://developer.helpscout.com/apps/getting-started/) to display content in the Inbox sidebar quickly and securely.

---

## Building a Public Integration

Will you be marketing your project to the public? Awesome! But before you launch anything, please read over our [brand guidelines](https://style.helpscout.com/) to make sure everything looks tip top. When it’s finished, be sure to let us know so we can tell everyone about it.
